title: Suspension (Temporary Pause) vs. Revocation (Complete Cancellation Requiring New Tests)

no_head_on_same_lane.note: No opposing vehicles facing each other; left shows one car ahead driving away, right shows one white car rear driving away.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Left foreground shows left-hand-drive cabin with driver on left and wheel on left; no right-side wheel.

single_bulb_signal.note: No traffic signal heads visible in either panel.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Left road shows yellow centerline on left of lane and white edge on right with traffic ahead driving on right; right test lane shows car driving away on right with cones, no left-side driving.

zero_text.note: All cards, papers, clipboard, plates and signs are blank shapes or simple icons (silhouette, star, hourglass-pause, X-cancel, car/cone pictograms); no letters, numbers, or words visible.

scene_match.note: Split-panel matches prompt: left pause-hourglass with intact card for suspension, right shredded card with X, clipboard exam and cone road-test for revocation.

result.summary: Split-panel Suspension vs Revocation illustration correctly shows temporary pause vs shredded card requiring new exam, with no text and correct US left-hand-drive and lane geometry.

teaching_correct.note: Teaches temporary hold vs complete cancellation requiring new written and road test from scratch without reversed priority or geometry error.

result.what_i_see: Split-panel graphic: left a driver in car with intact ID card and glowing hourglass-pause icon over a highway; right a stressed person writing with shredded ID card with red X, exam clipboard with car-cone diagram, examiner and coned white car behind.
